intro: Nannies build trust with families, read children's needs and manage a full day of care. The closest of the 25 careers below is Preschool Teachers, Except Special Education, with an 84% skill match and a BLS May 2025 median of $38,140, and several health and education roles pay considerably more.
why_it_works: Caring for children in a home means planning activities, handling emotions and talking with parents every day. O*NET rates social perceptiveness at 3.88 out of 5 for nannies and service orientation at 3.75. Teaching, aide and therapy assistant roles use the same care. BLS reports nannies within a broader childcare group, so this page shows medians instead of percent changes.
tips: Occupational Therapy Assistants earn $72,300 and are a 74% match after an associate program.
Keep CPR and first aid current; schools and clinics often require them.
Write down the routines and learning activities you plan; they support preschool teaching applications.

faq.q: What jobs can former nannies do?
faq.a: The closest matches are preschool teachers (84%), Psychiatric Aides (79%) and Occupational Therapy Assistants (74%), based on O*NET 31.0. School Bus Monitors are also 71% matched, with a median of $35,100, and need no extra training, which makes them a quick option while you study for something else.

faq.q: Which jobs for nannies pay the most?
faq.a: Among the 25 matches, the highest medians are Occupational Therapy Assistants at $72,300, preschool special education teachers at $64,830 and licensed practical nurses at $64,400, according to BLS May 2025 data. Each needs a certificate, license or degree, so plan the training before you leave nanny work.

faq.q: Do nannies need more education to change careers?
faq.a: For many paths, yes. 10 of the 25 matches need no more education than nannies already have, including 4 of the top 10. In a close match, 46% of workers have some college courses, so a certificate or associate program is common.

The skills that most often need work are troubleshooting, programming, systems analysis and equipment maintenance. Judgment and persuasion already rate 3.62 out of 5 for nannies in O*NET, so formal training in teaching or health care is the main step.
